Ticket #5185: AI scripts read players-tribute-memory (the tribute sent since clear-tribute-memory, per resource and player; the clear takes PLAYER and RESOURCE, no argument clears all) and amount-tribute-inefficiency (the player's tribute fee in percent: 30, 20 with Coinage). PR #5189 is open; the quick CI is green and Automerge merges it. One CI fix: the data check of per_resources.jsonl lists the new source tribute-inefficiency. Note for the owner on the PR: the -percent facts multiply by 100 (#4964), so up-resource-percent gives 3000 for a fee of 30. Next: the queue (no brief next line).
